mutants.label: [does-nothing] check never appends a fail result
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_direct_tier_changes_and_a_gated_id_is_removed: the guard's whole purpose is to fail this co-occurrence.

mutants.label: check drops the tier-hash-unchanged skip, always evaluating manifest removal
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_when_a_gated_id_is_removed_with_no_direct_tier_change: a gated-ID removal alone, with no tier change, must not fail.

mutants.label: check treats any tier change alone as a fail, ignoring manifest removal
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_when_direct_tier_changes_with_no_gated_id_removed: a tier change with no gated-ID removal must not fail — the positive conjunct.

mutants.label: check flips the manifest set-difference direction
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_direct_tier_changes_and_a_gated_id_is_removed and test_passes_when_direct_tier_changes_with_no_gated_id_removed together: swapping the direction misses a real removal and flags an addition instead.
